payload.description: Shared prompt-injection shield. Reviews untrusted chat messages, mail, attachments, and web content, with their images, in a fresh zero-authority model call and returns an advisory verdict with an optional validated extraction. Runs on the fast quality tier of the installation's default provider unless the owner picks another tier or forces an AI-session provider in its Settings tab; no model is ever chosen here, RedCompute picks the provider's mode for the tier. Optional for the apps that use it.
